name.description: Human-readable name of the charging location

coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates of the charging location. These values are returned as strings.

evses.description: List of Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE) at this location. Each EVSE may have multiple connectors.

parking_type.description: Parking type for the charging location.

operator.description: Information about the Charging Point Operator (CPO) managing this location

operator_display_name.description: An enhanced display name of the operator. This may be the operator name as found in the operator object, or the sub-operator of the location. When showing the location to end users, this is the operator name that should be shown.

opening_times.description: Operating hours of the charging location

directions.description: Navigation instructions to help locate the charging points, available in multiple languages

country.description: Three-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3) where the charging location is situated

state.description: State, region, or province where the charging location is situated. Format varies by country.

city.description: City where the charging location is situated

postal_code.description: Postal code of the charging location

address.description: Street address of the charging location

openNow.description: Indicates if the location is currently open based on opening_hours and local timezone. Use this for quick filtering of available locations.

is_green_energy.description: Indicates if the location uses renewable energy sources for charging, based on CPO-provided data

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this location's data was last updated. Use this to track changes and implement efficient polling.

id.description: Unique identifier for this connector. Use this ID when starting charging sessions.

standard.description: Physical connector type/standard (e.g., Type2, Combo, CHADEMO). Use `Combo` for CCS connectors.

power.description: Maximum power output in Watts. For AC chargers, this is typically between 3.7kW and 43kW. For DC chargers, typically between 50kW and 350kW.

price.description: Pricing information for this connector. Only available when retrieving a specific location.

description.description: Human-readable description of the pricing structure

priceIncludesVat.description: Indicates whether the price includes VAT or not (same meaning as for the CDR object)

vatRate.description: The VAT rate that is applied to the price (in case priceIncludesVat=true) or the VAT rate that should be applied to the price (in case priceIncludesVat=false)

elements.description: Possible prices for that connector, depending on restrictions

max_amperage.description: Maximum current in Amperes that this connector can provide

max_voltage.description: Maximum voltage in Volts that this connector can provide

ConnectorStandard.description: Connector standard accepted by the API. Use `Combo` for CCS connectors. `CHADEMO` is the preferred token; `Chademo` is a legacy alias.

Coordinates.description: Latitude and longitude values serialized as strings with fixed decimal precision. This schema is used in response payloads and in route-search points.

latitude.description: Latitude serialized as a string, for example `52.475911`.

longitude.description: Longitude serialized as a string, for example `13.350794`.

Evse.description: Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE) represents a charging station unit that may have multiple connectors. Only one connector can be active at a time.

physical_reference.description: The 'physical reference' is used by some CPOs to represent the label printed on the charging station itself. For example, in a charging location, the physical references could be '1', '2', '3', '4', for the four different charging stations

capabilities.description: Values: `PLUG_AND_CHARGE_CAPABLE`, `REMOTE_START_STOP_CAPABLE`. New values in this array might be added without notice, so unknown values should be handled gracefully.

last_updated.description: Time the EVSE data was last updated by the operator. Any EVSE data update changes it, so it does not show when the current `status` started. Use `status_since` from Get location live data for charging timing.

PriceComponent.description: Defines a single component of a charging price. A price can have multiple components (e.g., energy cost + time cost).

price.description: Cost in the currency stated above. VAT is included. Decimal number. For example, if currency is EUR and price is 1.10, the cost is €1.10. More information can be found in https://developer.plugsurfing.com/docs/geosearch#explanation

type.description: More information can be found in https://developer.plugsurfing.com/docs/geosearch#explanation

step_size.description: The smallest unit of usage that will be billed. Unit: seconds for `TIME`, `PARKING_TIME`, and `CONGESTION_TIME`; watt-hours (Wh) for `ENERGY`; ignored for `FLAT` and `CAPPED`. More information can be found in https://developer.plugsurfing.com/docs/geosearch#explanation

PriceElement.description: Defines a complete pricing structure that may apply under certain conditions. Multiple price elements may exist for different times or usage patterns.

price_components.description: List of individual price components that make up this pricing structure

restrictions.description: Conditions under which this price element applies. Multiple restrictions can be combined.

start_time.description: Time of day when this price starts applying (local time at the charging location)

end_time.description: Time of day when this price stops applying (local time at the charging location)

day_of_week.description: Days of the week when this price applies

min_duration.description: Minimum charging duration in seconds before this price applies (e.g., 7200 means this price applies after 2 hours)

max_duration.description: Maximum charging duration in seconds for this price to apply

min_kwh.description: Minimum energy consumption in kWh before this price applies

max_kwh.description: Maximum energy consumption in kWh for this price to apply

min_vehicle_soc.description: Minimum vehicle state of charge percentage for which this price element is valid

max_vehicle_soc.description: Maximum vehicle state of charge percentage for which this price element is valid

min_congestion_threshold.description: Minimum location utilization percentage for which this price element is valid

max_congestion_threshold.description: Maximum location utilization percentage for which this price element is valid

RegularHours.description: Only to be used if twentyfourseven = false

weekday.description: Number of day in the week, from Monday (1) till Sunday (7)
